How AI’s Evolution from Tools to Autonomous Colleagues Transforms Value Creation 

Michael Spencer and Raphaëlle d'OrnanoJun 25, 2025∙ Paid6412ShareDecoding Discontinuity for Higher Returns. You may have noticed AI Supremacy (Sitemap 2025) hasn’t covered Agentic AI much, I am still waiting for consensus on frameworks, protocols and leading hubs to manifest. However I think we can start to dip our toes into the topic. 

Will Agentic AI alter how we think of business models, defensive moats and AI vs. SaaS growth norms? Will it alter the very nature of entrepreneurship and innovation? That remains to be seen.  

Raphaëlle d'Ornano of Decoding Discontinuity Newsletter has written a very interesting series on Agentic AI. I wanted to bring some attention to it and asked her for a macro piece on the topic. That’s the topic of our deep dive today. We’ll be lowering our frequency of posts during the July-August period. 

Agentic Era Part 1. A Strategic Inflection Point Where Orchestration and Distribution - Not Model Power - Define AI Moats

Agentic Era Part 2: How the Architectural Battle Between Model Maximalists and Code Craftsmen is Shaping AI's Future

Agentic Era Part 3: How MCP and A2A Form the Invisible Operating System of the Autonomous AI Future

Agentic Era Part 4: The Exponential Economics of Agentic Applications

The Agentic Era Part 5: Building the Agentic Cloud

“ Agentic AI leads to what I call orchestration economics and looking at historical growth will not help determine future winners.”  - Raphaelle d'Ornano

A bit similar to how I admire many business thinkers on Substack like Gennaro Cuofano or Rich Holmes (Check out his YouTube), I find many of her ideas very stimulating.

🗼 Biography 

Raphaëlle D’Ornano, is the founder of D’Ornano + Co., a strategic advisory firm, and of Decoding Discontinuity, a research and investment platform exploring AI’s transformative impact on business models. 

Her proprietary Durable Growth Moat™ framework evaluates how companies sustain competitive advantages through AI-driven shifts, emphasizing architectural resilience and financial adaptability. Passionate about the discontinuity brought by GenAI, Raphaëlle challenges leaders and investors to rethink strategy and unlock enduring value in an AI-powered future. She is based in New York.
